resources.string: Time in social apps, video, messengers and games, with eye and brain breaks

How long social and feed apps, video, messengers and games were on the screen today and this week, read from Android’s usage history. The eye and brain reminders watch the social and feed apps only, where hopping from one to another without a break counts as one sitting; the rest is only counted. Nothing is written to the journal and nothing leaves the phone.
Android tells an app how long other apps were open only with Usage access. The sleep estimate uses the same access.
After a long sitting in a feed without a break
When the day’s total in these apps grows large
Rest for the eyes and the head
Every 20 minutes, look at something 6 metres away for 20 seconds.
Blink on purpose: the eyes blink far less while watching a screen and dry out.
An endless feed shifts attention every few seconds. A short walk or a few slow breaths let the brain settle.
Put the phone away an hour before sleep: bright screens push sleep later.
%1$s for %2$d min without a break. Look at something far away for 20 seconds and blink a few times.
